sections.title: New Member Registration
sections.context: A man is talking to a receptionist at a sports centre to inquire about membership options and facilities.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Good morning! Welcome to the Riverside Sports Complex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Hi there. I’ve just moved to the area and I’m looking to join a local gym or sports centre. I saw your sign outside and thought I'd pop in.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That’s great to hear. We have a lot of different options depending on what you're looking for. To start, I’ll need to take down some of your personal details for our system.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Sure, no problem.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: First of all, what is your full name?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: It’s Mark Peterson. That’s P-E-T-E-R-S-O-N.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Thank you, Mark. And what is your current home address?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I’m staying at 14 Oak Street... Oh, wait, sorry, that was my old apartment. I’m actually at number 41 Oak Street now. I still get them mixed up.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Haha, I understand. 41 Oak Street. Do you have a contact number we can reach you on?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: 0-7-7-0-0, 9-0-0, 3-2-1. Perfect. Now, we have three main membership tiers: Basic, Silver, and Premium. The Basic tier covers the gym only, Silver includes the swimming pool, and Premium gives you access to everything including the spa and sauna.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I think the Premium one sounds best. I’ve been training for a marathon and the sauna would be great for recovery.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Excellent choice. And when would you like the membership to commence? We can start it today if you like.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Today is the 10th of September... I think I'll wait until I get my next paycheck. Let’s set the start date for the 15th September.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Understood. Starting on the 15th. Now, let me give you a quick overview of our classes and facilities. We have a variety of group sessions. Are you interested in any particular sport?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I used to do a lot of yoga, but I want to try something that helps with core strength more specifically.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: In that case, I’d highly recommend our Pilates class. It’s held every Tuesday and Thursday evening. It's very popular with our runners.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: That sounds perfect. Do I need to bring anything special for that?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: We provide the mats and any weights required, but for hygiene reasons, every member must bring their own towel to the sessions.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: That makes sense. What about storage? Are there lockers available?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Yes, we have plenty of lockers in the changing rooms. They aren't free, though. There is a small charge of 2 pounds per use, or you can rent one for the whole month.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I'll probably just pay as I go. What are the opening hours? I usually work late.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: We open at 6:00 am for the early birds. On weekdays, we close at 10:30 pm, which should give you enough time after work. On weekends, we close a bit earlier at 8:00 pm.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: 10:30 pm is great. One last thing, I noticed a lot of cars outside. Is there dedicated parking for members?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Yes, we have a large underground parking area. You just need to scan your membership card at the gate to get in for free. Otherwise, it's quite expensive to park on the street.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That's a relief. Well, I think I'm all set. Should I pay the registration fee now?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Yes, if you could please follow me to the terminal...
